::: {#exr-exp-score-fn}
#### Score function of an exponential variable

Derive the score function for a single exponential random variable $X$,
with respect to the mean parameter $\pmean$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::::{#sol-exp-score-fn}

The exponential density with mean $\pmean$ is
$\p(X = x) = \pmean^{-1} e^{-x/\pmean}$ for $x > 0$,
so $\loglik = \llexpmean$, and:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&\eqdef \deriv{\pmean}\loglik
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-\logf{\pmean}} - \deriv{\pmean} \frac{x}{\pmean}
&& \text{(exponential log-likelihood; linearity)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{\pmean} + \frac{x}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(derivatives of $\log \pmean$ and $\pmean^{-1}$)}\\
&= \frac{x - \pmean}{\pmean^2}
&& \text{(common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}}
&& \text{($\E{X} = \pmean$ and $\Var{X} = \pmean^2$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

::::
